description: A fast, short-range striker with Mirror Image.
tactics:
When Mirror Image is up - approach and do as much damage as possible.
When Mirror Image is down - kite.

description: A support with a multipurpose empowering aura.
tactics:
Don't approach to enemies closer than 30 feet.
Move towards allies otherwise, attempt to protect groups.

description: A long-range striker that can get close and punish movement.
tactics:
When Overwatch is up or you have melee allies - approach and do as much damage as possible.
When Overwatch is down - kite.

description: A fragile striker that leaps to knock down opponents.
tactics:
Attack the least armored opponent with Leaping Knockdown.
Make an immediate attack on prone enemies no matter what.
Flee if no enemies are prone and re-engage when Leaping Knockdown is back up.

description: A striker that deals reliable damage.
tactics: Fire on the most heavily armored opponent until they are dead.

description: A controller that adds obstacles to the battlefield.
tactics:
Attempt to divide enemy party with Obstacle if 0/1 blockers.
Attempt to separate wounded allies and enemies with Obstacle if 1/2 blockers.
Attempt to protect self desperately, ignore blockers.
Try to set up for next Obstacle after casting.

description: A shoving defender that grants temporary Hit Points in an aura.
tactics:
Hold back and attempt to set up a defensive area where allies can come heal
Shove enemies away and then move back

description: A high-damage striker with forced random attacks and movement.
tactics:
At the start, attempt to split up as much as possible from allies and other berserkers.
Use your only controlled action for attacks.
Don't be tactical.

description: An artillery archetype that denies areas with delayed shots.
tactics:
Approach cautiously and attempt to get some free hits.
Delay initiative.
Once enemies seem to need an area, start denying it.
Each turn, back up and continue firing on that area.

description: A striker that charges through enemies and can apply an armor debuff.
tactics:
Attempt to set up a proper charge without obstructions.
If you can't, charge anyway.
When charge is down attack and double move, trying to build distance again.

description: A striker that grapples and kidnaps opponents.
tactics:
Target the furthest opponent for kidnapping.
Focus on grabbing and kidnapping rather than restraining.
Stick on them and attempt to bring them away from their group.

description: A slow defender with a powerful attack that stuns itself.
tactics:
Dumb ogre monster.
Attack the nearest opponent and overcommitted slam immediately.
Rise and fight while slowed until overcommitted slam is back up.

description: A summoner that creates a minion every turn.
tactics:
Set up 3 ranged minions. Use other actions for cover. Go Prone if needed.
Start sending melee minions after that.

description: A grappling defender that challenges a single opponent.
tactics:
Mark the most martial enemy as rival and attempt to neutralize them.
Focus on restraining and not damaging.

description: A controller that creates hazardous terrain beneath itself.
tactics:
Greedily deny as much terrain as possible.
Only fight on your own terrain, counterattacking once and then proceeding to deny.

description: A fragile, fast, hard-to-hit controller.
tactics:
You recklessly consider yourself invincible until you take any hit or status.
Then you switch to hit and run tactics.

description: A slowing trap in one square that covers the adjacent squares.
tactics: Placeholder

description: A slow, fragile minion.
tactics: Placeholder

description: A visible trap that affects a single square.
tactics: Placeholder

description: A support that can teleport allies or hide them.
tactics:
Highest Priority: Veiling allies that are in cover.
Second Priority: Swapping wounded allies with fresh ones to protect them.
Third Priority: Helping allies go where they want.
Fourth Priority: Swapping away enemy vanguard

description: A slow artillery sniper with a single teleport.
tactics:
Wait for opponents to get close before opening strike. (delay)
Once Cover is blown, start moving to make equidistant cover
Jump to other cover if enemies get close.

description: An area-of-effect trap already hidden on the battlefield.
tactics: Placeholder

description: A support that shares its large health pool with allies.
tactics:
You want at least one ally by you at all times. If alone, approach ally.
If you have an ally, avoid enemies as much as possible.

description: A short-range defender with area-of-effect and retaliatory attacks.
tactics:
Try to push up against walls and get in short ranged halways if possible.
Prioritize moving closer for a good blast instead of weakly attacking.
Refuse to damage allies with blast (except in rebuke)

description: A long-range artillery that fires delayed strikes that cannot miss.
tactics:
Hold first DMM until you can get N-1 enemies.
Settle for whatever on later DMMs.

description: A fragile minion that cannot move.
tactics: Placeholder

description: A striker that challenges a single opponent and uses disarm and trip.
tactics:
Target any opponent you see using manuevers or being martially clever.
Always use manuevers before attacking.
Always alternate manuevers.

description: A controller that plants mines on single squares.
tactics:
Deny area near allies to complicate movement.
Set 3 mines and then use thrown burst.
Don't use final burst tactically.

description: A striker that gets a huge bonus for attacking the same opponent round after round.
tactics:
Dumb animal.
Attacks nearest unless it has branded anyone, then only focus on them.

description: A support that can see invisible creatures, reveal them, and dispel magic.
tactics:
Seek cover and fire from cover.
Hold revealing light until an enemy hides or goes invisible.
Hold Dispel Magic utnil the first debuff.

description: A defender with multiple reactive strikes that trips opponents.
tactics:
Separate from allies in order to control ground more effectively.
Trip each opponent first. Future Reactions against them go for damage.
Use Advanced trip on your turn against all enemies.

description: A artillery that marks distant opponents.
tactics:
Target most dexterous opponent for paint target.
If a paint attempt fails, do not attempt to paint the same person again until you have gone through aeveryone . Do not move until enemies are within 30 feet.

description: A striker that stalks and hides in cover.
tactics:
Stay hidden until enemies approach in range.
Flee and melt into cover after firing.

description: A support that heals allies and chooses a type of buff to cast.
tactics:
Never move from starting location - set up a hospital.
Begin with applying blue buff to vanguard
Apply red buff after vanguard starts fighting.
Apply green buff if enemies are nearby.
Heal after that.
Buff Self and Heal Self as lowest priority.

description: A controller that sets slowing traps and deploys Cover Screens.
tactics:
Throw one cover screen close and one far.
Immediately move towards trap location.
Attack in response only. Otherwise just set up more traps.

description: A controller that bleeds adjacent opponents and sickens opponents that are alone.
tactics:
Highest Priority: Bound by Blood on melee, healers, other
Second Priority: Divided by Plague on anyone.
Third Priorty: Bound by Blood on ally/enemy pairs.
